name: Standing Array
description: Lay a deep array whose lines stand firm against any single blow and hold the patch within.

name: Anchored Matrix
description: Anchor a matrix to the ground and the maker's breath so that foes inside it cannot leave.

name: Grand Lattice
description: Spread a grand lattice that shields all who stand behind it and answers each blow in turn.

name: Deep Seal
description: Press a deep seal into the ground so that nothing laid within it can be moved by another hand.

name: Rooted Draw
description: Root the array in the earth and draw the force of an attack down through it to ground.

name: Hinge Phase
description: Pass through the array as through a hinge and arrive at any linked mark in the same breath.

name: Echo Matrix
description: Hold a matrix that echoes every movement within the reach of the array back to the maker.

name: Mending Grid
description: Lay a grid over the wounded that closes each wound along the lines of the pattern.

name: Silent Array
description: Lay an array with no hum and no light that presses on every foe before they know it stands.

name: Great Lattice
description: Raise a great lattice about the maker and company that stands against the heaviest blow.

name: Endless Grid
description: Spread a grid of sealed lines that runs on past the sight of any foe within it.

name: Boundless Array
description: Raise an array with no fixed edge that grows to the destructive ceiling of its tier and tears all that stands within.

name: Eternal Pattern
description: Fix a pattern into the place itself so that the array keeps standing after every stone is gone and the maker has left it.
